title: 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste generated in 2024
content: In 2024, 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste were generated in the EU. Household disposal accounted for over half of this amount. During the same year, 1.4 million tonnes of textile waste were treated, corresponding to 63% of all textile waste generated that year.
